audience: dance studio owners and managers who run classes, events and students in BailaYa

useCases.title: List the classes with their instructor and room
useCases.text: List the studio's classes with date, time, instructor, room and capacity. Open one class by id for its details.

useCases.title: Review a student's level and status
useCases.text: When the studio owner asks, list the students and open one record to check its level and status.

useCases.title: Check events, rooms and team before a workshop
useCases.text: List the studio's events, rooms and team members before you plan a new workshop.

useCases.title: Add a class to the booking page
useCases.text: Create one class occurrence on a date. The class becomes visible on the studio's booking page.

useCases.title: Change or delete a class
useCases.text: Change the time, instructor, room, capacity or price of one class. Delete one class, or every occurrence of a series. A delete cannot be undone.
